retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grungy portrait framed by a thick yellow border containing repetitive, distressed block typography and white paint-splatter overlays.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central lo-fi, grainy portrait of a subject with tattoos and street style, encased in a vibrant yellow frame. The frame is filled with a grid-like repetition of heavy, distressed sans-serif text. White, textured 'bleach' or 'paint' splatters overlap the image and frame, creating a DIY, screen-printed feel.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast yellow frame vs. desaturated central portrait
Repetitive block text vs. fluid white paint splatters
Gritty photographic grain vs. flat graphic color blocks
Sharp frame edges vs. organic, messy texture overlays
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or photocopy noise on the subject
Distressed, eroded texture on all typographic elements
White paint-like distressing overlapping the bottom and right edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hand, framed by the high-contrast yellow border.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central subject, move outward to the repetitive text border, and follow the white paint splatters across the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with texture and repetitive patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Yellow (Border and background for text)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (Text and desaturated shadows in portrait)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow frame surrounds a low-saturation, high-contrast photographic center.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme distressing and erosion applied to all glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges that mimic ink bleed or old photocopy degradation
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, repetitive block sans-serif for the frame paired with a delicate, handwritten script overlay.

avoid: Centering the text inside the image area

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, industrial skeleton needed for the border text.
Mimics the fluid, handwritten signature overlay.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, desaturated lo-fi portrait of a person with tattoos and a hat, framed by a solid thick yellow border. Apply white paint splatter textures to the bottom left and right edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add repetitive, distressed black block text inside the yellow border area. Add a white, fluid script signature in the bottom right corner overlapping the portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow border vibrant and thick?
Is the text in the border heavily distressed and repetitive?
Are there white paint-like splatters overlapping the image?
Is the central portrait grainy and desaturated?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the repetitive text

mustAchieve: Balanced chaos between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow is not muddy or mustard-toned.
Check that the white splatters look like physical media (paint/bleach).
Verify the text is treated as a graphic pattern rather than just a caption.
Confirm the portrait maintains a gritty, lo-fi texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast portrait + apply heavy film grain + wrap in a yellow border + fill border with repetitive distressed sans-serif + overlay white ink splatters.
